metadata.layout: Explicit measured regions; the generated atlas is arranged 4 by 4 but is not an evenly divided grid.
metadata.coordinate_space: Regions are [atlas_x, atlas_y, width, height] in source pixels; foot points are absolute atlas [x,y] coordinates.
metadata.body_height_measurement: 232 source pixels, representative neutral torso/head/ore-to-ground height excluding raised pickaxe. Use one common body scale for all frames.
metadata.foot_measurement: Ground midpoint beneath claw feet, assessed visually and checked against alpha foot bounds. Release frame 10 uses foot y=917, not the lower pickaxe tip at y=931. Hurt frame 13 excludes the low pickaxe blade.
quality_notes: Body proportions and materials are consistent; attack and hit-reaction silhouettes are visibly distinct.
Facing remains near-frontal three-quarter rather than an unambiguous screen-right profile after the single permitted layout repair.
Walk uses short steps; several overlapping leg poses have modest left/right separation and need playback validation.
Thin red and yellow-green edge color fringes remain in the generated transparent source.
Regions preserve every major visible connected component and add small margins; do not derive regions by dividing image_size by four.

provenance.repair_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: image 1 is the sixteen-frame transparent M01 monster animation atlas. Image 2 is the original monster identity reference.
Make one targeted production-layout correction to image 1: normalize all 16 sprite compositions to a visibly 3/4 SCREEN-RIGHT facing view and give every frame generous clear transparent margins. Current leftmost pickaxes touch or extend past canvas and row/column boundaries. Fix this completely. Keep EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows and same sixteen animation poses in the same row-major order; do not replace poses with generic stances, do not lose visible walking leg alternation, windup attack, downward pickaxe strike and backward hit reaction. The orange facial slit should point diagonally toward SCREEN RIGHT consistently; pickaxe-side placement may mirror as necessary to establish facing right. Preserve original character identity/material and the identity details in image 2.
Invisible equal 4x4 cell layout on square canvas. Each sprite must be comfortably isolated in its cell with at least 8% of cell width clear margin on every side INCLUDING all weapon tips and claws. Entire feet and weapon are inside its own cell. Same body scale across all 16; leave more air above smaller bent poses rather than rescaling them. Body height head-to-foot about 58% of the cell height at neutral stance; weapon can use remaining space. Ground anchor is centered x=.5 y=.84 per cell. No global positional slide, no turned-back figures, no overlapping neighbors. Preserve transparent background and crisp detailed game art. No grid, labels, numbering, text, ground, shadow, motion streaks or visual effects. Exactly sixteen separate complete monsters.
provenance.image_processing: Final PNG copied unchanged from built-in image generation output. Pillow/NumPy used only for read-only alpha inspection; no programmatic image edits.
